{{Quote|Prisoner was just spotted in the east wing, cell block 121811.|A Coruscant Guard clone trooper|<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>}}
'''Cell block 121811''' was a cell block in the east wing of the [[Republic military base]]'s [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The cell block was primarily controlled by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]].<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />

During her [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escape]] from the base, fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] passed by the cell block.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />
